'''2006 Alderaan Regional''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship held on Saturday 8 April 2006 at noon at Eudemonia, 2154 University Ave, Berkeley, California. [[Steve Sanders]] promoted it on the Players Committee forum; it was six rounds with a mandatory final confrontation, decklists were required, and the Ultimate Prize Package was on offer.<ref name="pcf-9445-129853">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=129853#129853 Alderaan Regionals - April 8, 2006], Steve Sanders (Shran), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 March 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617234454/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=129853 Internet Archive]</ref> The two byes to Day 2 of the [[2006 World Championship]] went to [[Joe Olson]] and [[Clayton Atkin]].<ref name="pcf-9443-132859">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=132859#132859 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Steve Sanders (Shran), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-9443-130633">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=130633#130633 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Mike Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Eudemonia, 2154 University Ave, Berkeley, California<ref name="pcf-9445-129853" />
* '''Dates:''' 8 April 2006<ref name="pcf-9445-129853" />
* '''Time:''' noon<ref name="pcf-9445-129853" />
* '''Format:''' six rounds with a mandatory final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-9445-129853" />
* '''Prizes:''' Ultimate Prize Package<ref name="pcf-9445-129853" />

== Organization ==

Sanders wrote that "I think, fifteen players" had played the previous year's regional ([[2005 Alderaan Regional]]) and that he expected about as many in 2006.<ref name="pcf-9445-129853" />

== Results ==

On 20 April 2006 Sanders asked for Joe Olson and Clayton Atkins (as he spelled the name) to be added to the 2006 World Championship qualifier list for Alderaan 2006,<ref name="pcf-9443-132859" /> and they appear on the list kept by [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]].<ref name="pcf-9443-130633" /> No winner or standings were posted in the topics read.
